about: Scenarios (docs/ENGINEERING_SYSTEM.md section 3.2). State is derived from the proof each names; a scenario is never itself proof. PROTOCOL-class: changing this file needs an approval record.

scenarios.name: An unmatched payment is the ledger only
given: a value.moved observation (out)
no open obligation of the same amount from the same source
then: a ledger entry exists
the effect is NONE with the ledger flag

proof.check: a payment with no open obligation is the ledger only [0]
spending and income with nothing open are the ledger only

scenarios.name: One adapter has nothing to corroborate
given: several value.moved facts from different senders of one adapter
the same amount on the same day
then: each fact is its own movement
mustNot: two senders of one adapter are merged into one movement

proof.check: one adapter: every fact is its own movement, even the same amount on the same day from two senders
one adapter, nothing to pair: 2 movement(s), witnesses [1, 1], in every order

scenarios.name: Two adapters seeing one payment make one movement
given: an SMS fact and a statement fact
same direction, currency and amount, a day apart
then: one movement with two witnesses
shown under one stable account

proof.check: two adapters, the same direction, currency and amount on the same day: one movement with two witnesses
two adapters, same payment: 1 movement(s), witnesses [2], in every order
it is shown under the account of its first witness by adapter, so it is always the same account

scenarios.name: Two real identical payments stay two
given: two payments of the same amount on one day
each seen by SMS and by a statement
then: two movements, each with two witnesses
they say they paired by count

proof.check: two payments, each seen by both: two movements of two witnesses each, not one of four
two real identical payments stay two, each seen by both: 2 movement(s), witnesses [2, 2], in every order
two seen by SMS and one by the statement: two movements, one witnessed twice and one once
a movement holds at most one witness per adapter

scenarios.name: The pairing window is one day
given: two adapters stating the same payment
when: they are a day apart, and then two days apart
then: a day pairs; two days does not

proof.check: a day apart still pairs
two days apart does not
two days apart is two payments: 2 movement(s), witnesses [1, 1], in every order

scenarios.name: Different amount, direction or currency never pair
given: two adapters, one differing in amount, direction or currency
then: they are separate movements
mustNot: money out paired with money in

proof.check: a different amount does not
a different direction does not
a different currency does not
out and in of the same amount are two: 2 movement(s), witnesses [1, 1], in every order

scenarios.name: A reference the source gave decides the pairing
given: two facts of different adapters, each with a reference
then: equal references pair; different ones never do; an inferred reference is not one

proof.check: the same reference pairs them
two references that are both the source's own and differ are different payments
an inferred reference is not one: it does not stop a pairing
references the source gave, and differ: different payments: 2 movement(s), witnesses [1, 1], in every order

scenarios.name: The ledger does not depend on the order facts arrive in
given: a mixed set of facts from two adapters
when: they are given in forty different orders, and twice over
then: the same movements every time
mustNot: a different pairing for a different order
a double count when read twice

proof.check: the same observations in any order give the same movements
and reading everything twice changes nothing
the fingerprint is a hash of facts, and moves when a fact moves

scenarios.name: A month is per account and per currency, in the person's calendar
given: facts across months, accounts and two currencies
then: a line for each account and currency, amounts to the cent
the month is in the person's zone
mustNot: a fact in the wrong month at midnight

proof.check: a line for each account and currency, in a fixed order, amounts in whole units with two places
the month is the person's calendar month, not UTC's
the months that have a movement, oldest first

scenarios.name: The ledger screen says moved, never spent or earned
given: the ledger code and screen
then: only the disclaimer names spent and earned
mustNot: a total called spending or income

proof.check: it never says spent or earned
the screen says spent and earned once each: to say it does not show them
the screen is secure like Recall

scenarios.name: The ledger replayed from sealed facts equals the live one
given: facts kept in sealed bundles
the same facts live
when: the ledger is rebuilt from the bundles
then: the fingerprints are equal
mustNot: a movement lost or invented by keeping

proof.check: replay == live: the ledger from the sealed bundles has the same fingerprint as the ledger from the live facts
replay holds every kept fact and not the note

scenarios.name: A quiet sender's money leaves the ledger and comes back
given: kept facts from two senders
when: one is marked quiet, then taken back
then: its movements leave the ledger, then return
mustNot: its kept bundles erased by the mark

proof.check: a quiet sender's money is out of the ledger while it is quiet
and back in when taken back
marking a source quiet does not erase it

scenarios.name: Evidence-only facts are not kept
given: an information.noted fact beside a bill and a payment
then: the note is not sealed; the bill and payment are
mustNot: evidence-only facts widening what the phone holds

proof.check: information.noted is not kept; the bill is
bundles by source and month: BANKA's two months, BANKB's one, the statement's one (the note is evidence only and is not kept)

scenarios.name: Erasing everything kept is explicit and total
given: kept bundles
then: every key is destroyed; nothing replays
the record that they were kept stays, empty
mustNot: erasing as a side effect of switching keeping off

proof.check: erasing everything destroys every bundle
the record that they were kept stays, with nothing in it
erasing is an explicit, confirmed act on the screen, and nothing else erases the kept facts

scenarios.name: Keeping needs the person's yes, asked first
given: a Look at a message backup
then: a dialog says what is kept and for how long; the yes is recorded; then facts are sealed

proof.check: one place keeps facts — the Keep dialog on the Sources screen
and it asks first, then records the person's yes before it keeps
a revoked capability stops keeping: keepFacts is only reached from the dialog, which only the button opens

scenarios.name: Switching keeping off stops it and erases nothing
given: keeping is on and a bundle is kept
when: the person switches it off; or a restore brings the grant back without the device flag
then: keeping stops, the bundle stays
the history is made to agree with the device
mustNot: a grant the device does not exercise

proof.check: switching off stops it and says so
and erases nothing
a restore that brings the grant back without the flag is made to agree
saying yes twice records one grant

scenarios.name: The journal holds no amount, sender or account of what was kept
given: facts kept for real senders and amounts
then: only blinded keys, months and counts
mustNot: a sender code, an amount or an account in the journal

proof.check: the journal holds no amount, sender code or account: only blinded keys, months and counts
the journal holds no sender code, no amount, no id and no fact
nor does anything on disk, in the clear

scenarios.name: Every service message has exactly one disposition
given: a small inbox of bills, payments, a refund, a promo, a code and an unreadable message
then: each message is LOOP, CLOSURE_CANDIDATE, LEDGER_ONLY, NOT_A_LOOP, AMBIGUOUS or UNMAPPABLE, once
they add up to the service total
mustNot: a message counted twice or not at all

proof.check: every service message has exactly one disposition: they add up to the service total
the payment that matches the open bill is a closure candidate
a payment with nothing open is ledger only
a quiet sender's messages are not loops, and the dispositions still add up

scenarios.name: A keep that fails part-way leaves what was there
given: an older bundle for a source and month
when: sealing the new bundle or recording it fails
then: the older bundle is still the live one
mustNot: an unrecorded sealed bundle left behind

scenarios.name: A statement that does not reproduce its own balances is refused whole
given: a CSV whose rows do not add up to its balance column
then: the whole file is refused
nothing is kept

scenarios.name: Payee and narration text never leave the sealed bundle
given: a statement row with a payee and narration
when: it is imported, kept, exported and probed
then: the text exists only inside the sealed bundle
mustNot: payee text in the journal, an export, a fit report or a probe line
